{{Quote|Subject 41 is a moisture farmer captured by Jabba's men. No outstanding characteristics. Subject still in orientation, waiting for test stim to be administered.|White Thranta internal medical report.|<ref name="SWG:DI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Digital Infection|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
'''Tork Magzyn''', later known as '''subject 41''', was a [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Tork Magzyn was captured by henchmen of the [[White Thranta Shipping Company]] in order to serve as a test subject for unethical and dreadful medical experiments. Most of the "subjects" did not survive the experiments.<ref name="SWG:DI" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tork Magzyn was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DI" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Tork Magzyn was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
